method: dumpV3BridgeRetention() — per-bridge-entry transitive LiveTracer walk. NIX_V3_DUMP_BRIDGE_RETENTION=1 unlimited (HNE); =20 sampled (M5).

HNE.interpretation: Three latest attrs entries (likely nixpkgs root chain) each hold 636 MB transitively, sharing the same subgraph. 27 closure-bridges from intermediate calls hold essentially nothing. Lever: drop the 3 heavy entries.

M5.interpretation: Sampled at 1-in-503 stride: closure#0 holds nothing; ALL others (closures 503-9557) each hold 952.92 MB transitively. They share the same evaluation subgraph (cardano-node flake outputs). Lever: bulk eviction; can't drop individual entries because survivors still pin the graph.

cross_workload_pattern.common: Bridges hold ~99% retention at end-of-eval. Clearing all bridges → ~1 MB live.

different.HNE: few heavy + many light (sparse heavy pattern)
different.M5: many heavy sharing same subgraph (dense heavy pattern)

cross_workload_pattern.implication: Weak-bridge eviction is easy on HNE (target 3 heavy), challenging on M5 (must drop all heavy together). End-of-eval bulk clear works on both.
